Name: Stardew Valley ESP
Author: tomdc
Description:
[size=1][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/3917/3917-1557968644-197950069.png[/img]

[/size]
﻿[size=5]Installation
[/size][list=1]
[*][size=3]Download [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=3]Download this mod and unzip the contents into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font][/size]
[*][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI (see [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Getting_started]here[/url]﻿ for full instructions on using SMAPI)[/size]
[/list]

[size=5]Compatability
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Tested on Windows with Stardew Valley v1.3.36[/size]
[*][size=3]Should work for Mac/Linux[/size]
[*][size=3]Untested in Multiplayer, but should be good because the are only "graphics" mods[/size]
[/list]

[size=5]Settings
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]A file called settings.json will be created in [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font][/size]
[*][size=3]Settings can be modified them ingame. Open the menu with `K`. If the file is edited manually while in-game, reload settings with `L`. These hotkeys can also be changed through the menu.
[/size]
[*][size=3]When first used, only the first entity encountered when exiting your farmhouse will be colored. You can add more colors through the menu.
[/size]
[/list]

[size=5]Issues
[/size][list]
[*][size=5][size=3]As this is a work in progress, please forward all issues to the [/size][url=https://github.com/rei2hu/stardewvalley-esp][size=3]github[/size][/url]﻿[/size]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Stardew Valley ESP
Manifest.Description: Adds name tags to in-game entities for easier detection and finding.
Manifest.Author: reimu
